title: Account screens: every step, today vs this work

steps.headline: Step 1 of 4: the Account page. Nothing changes here.
steps.changed: Nothing. The same three cards, the same buttons.
steps.notice: Sign out everywhere is not on this page. It is one level down, on Edit account.

steps.path: Account, press Edit account, scroll to Danger zone
steps.headline: Step 2 of 4: the Danger zone gains one button, Sign out everywhere, above Delete account.
steps.changed: This is the only thing added to what you see before pressing anything. It is the same red outlined button as Delete account.
steps.notice: What it does: ends your YouCoded account sign-in on every computer and phone, this one included. You sign in again with GitHub. Your account and data are untouched.
steps.risk: Two red buttons now sit in the Danger zone instead of one.

steps.path: Danger zone, press Sign out everywhere
steps.headline: Step 3 of 4: pressing it asks once before doing anything.
steps.changed: New: a one-line red note, then Cancel and Sign out everywhere. Delete account hides until you press Cancel. Same layout as Delete account's own confirm (step 4), without the typed word.
steps.notice: After it works, this window shows you signed out. If the server can't be reached, a red line under it says nothing changed and you are still signed in.
steps.risk: Phones paired for remote access stay paired; the note doesn't say so.

steps.headline: Step 4 of 4: Delete account's confirm. Nothing changes here.
steps.changed: Same words, same typed word, same buttons. While it is open, Sign out everywhere hides, so it looks exactly like today.
steps.notice: This is the existing pattern step 3 copies.
